A-01.requirement: Store every original file unchanged, with its hash, in private storage; create the submission and documents; queue the job
A-01.implementation: Immutable originals, content hash and private storage
A-01.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-01.acceptance_test: Saved original hashes match; no overwrite on retry

A-02.requirement: Detect the format (audio, digital PDF, scanned PDF, image, text), the script per page, and the template by fingerprint (known: EDP Idea Brief, EDP Business Plan, platform exports; otherwise "unknown")
A-02.local_strategy: Local file signatures/layout, language-model candidate only when needed
A-02.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-02.acceptance_test: All organiser formats classified or explicitly unknown

A-03.requirement: Convert to 16 kHz mono with ffmpeg; split at silences with a voice-activity detector into chunks under 30 s, each with its start time; reject near-silent or clipped audio with a re-record prompt
A-03.local_strategy: Installed ffmpeg; silencedetect pause baseline; Silero-class VAD comparison and threshold tuning not yet validated
A-03.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-03.acceptance_test: 16 kHz mono chunks under 30 s preserve time anchors

A-04.requirement: Transcribe chunks in parallel within Sarvam's rate limits, with language detected per chunk; output segments with ID, language, text, start and end
A-04.execution: worker; optional Android after capability checks
A-04.local_strategy: faster-whisper small (MIT) via local/models; hi/mr/te/bn/en supported but unevaluated; Odia has no local model and stays pending
A-04.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-04.acceptance_test: Evaluate all aud-* files, code mixing, timestamps and language labels

A-05.requirement: Extract text spans with bounding box, font and colour, plus drawn lines and table rules; rebuild question and answer cells from the layout, not the content-stream order
A-05.implementation: Digital PDF geometry and table reconstruction
A-05.local_strategy: pdfplumber + pypdfium2 (permissive) geometry; organiser PDFs not yet run
A-05.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-05.acceptance_test: Spans/bboxes/lines reconstruct Q&A independent of stream order

A-06.requirement: Score each Indic text span for corruption (orphan vowel signs, broken conjuncts, unknown syllables). Spans below the threshold are re-read from the rendered page by OCR. Organiser PDFs from Chromium and Word lose pre-base vowel signs, so this is routine
A-06.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-06.acceptance_test: Corrupt MR/TE/HI samples rerender and reread with confidence

A-07.requirement: Render pages at 300 dpi; detect blur and skew; read with Sarvam Document AI, falling back to a vision model for handwriting with low confidence; resolve ditto marks in tables; return per-region confidence
A-07.implementation: Scans, layout, handwriting and low-confidence crops
A-07.local_strategy: Tesseract 5 + tessdata_best six languages; handwriting accuracy unknown; no vision fallback installed
A-07.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-07.acceptance_test: Handwritten organiser samples meet eval targets or remain explicitly unreadable

A-08.requirement: Detect struck-through or scribbled text (a drawn line through a span, grey versus blue ink, scribbles on scans). Keep both values; the correction becomes the answer and the struck value is shown as history
A-08.local_strategy: Geometry/raster rules + validated local vision candidate
A-08.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-08.acceptance_test: Final corrected values match manifest while struck originals remain linked

A-09.requirement: Pair questions with answers whatever the template. Map each question to a canonical field (Appendix B) by matching against a multilingual question bank with embeddings, confirmed by the LLM. Questions the template did not ask are recorded as "not asked". Unknown questions are kept as additional Q&A
A-09.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-09.acceptance_test: Custom/changed forms distinguish missing, not asked and unknown Q&A

A-10.requirement: Move name, phone, email, exact address and social category into the encrypted entrepreneur record. Redact them from every segment before any LLM call, and mark their regions on page images for blurring
A-10.local_strategy: Local redaction rules/models; encrypted private fields
A-10.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-10.acceptance_test: Phone/email/name never reach model/map payloads or partner images

A-11.requirement: Identify the language of every answer separately; translate each segment to English, keeping its ID; transliterate on request. Code-mixed answers are translated whole, never truncated to one language
A-11.local_strategy: Rule-based per-answer language ID; IndicTrans2 Indic→English (MIT, code reviewed and hash-pinned) as the local translator; Opus-MT rejected
A-11.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-11.acceptance_test: Six languages/code mixing retain segIds and satisfy parity targets

A-12.requirement: Fill the canonical idea fields, "problem addressed" and a one-line summary. Each field cites segment IDs. A field with no citation is dropped, never invented
A-12.local_strategy: Local JSON adapter + schema/evidence validators; model unvalidated
A-12.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-12.acceptance_test: At least 90% canonical field accuracy; drop uncited claims

A-13.requirement: Run the checks in section 12: completeness, relevance per answer, consistency, plausibility, language mismatch, placeholder contacts
A-13.local_strategy: Ordinary rules + local model relevance checks
A-13.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-13.acceptance_test: Missing recall ≥95%, precision ≥90%; fully irrelevant submissions unassessable

A-14.requirement: Recompute the EDP Business Plan model (Appendix B.2): C = A − B, D = C, G = E + F, H = G / 30, I = E × 6, L = J + K, M = L / 30, N = min(1,00,000 − D − I, J × 5), and cash-book totals against A, E × 6 and J × 5. Also check simpler forms: investment = self + loan, and revenue against price × volume. Every mismatch shows the written value, the expected value and the anchor
A-14.implementation: EDP formulas A–N and cash-book checks
A-14.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-14.acceptance_test: All seeded financial errors detected with written/expected/formula evidence

A-15.requirement: Match on a salted hash of the normalised phone and email, plus embedding similarity. Flag possible duplicates and resubmissions; detect placeholder contacts; never merge automatically
A-15.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-15.acceptance_test: All planted duplicates flagged, zero automatic merges; shared phones handled

A-16.requirement: For app submissions, write 3 to 5 questions about missing or unclear fields; translate and voice them; answers re-run the reading and extraction stages. For imported files, draft a request for information in the applicant's language
A-16.local_strategy: Local JSON generator + translation; device/local TTS
A-16.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-16.acceptance_test: 3–5 useful questions, original language, answers rerun correct stages
A-16.notes: Text pitches (D-33): up to 3 questions a round until every topic is answered or declined; answers re-run extraction. English only; translation and voice pending; imported-file requests for information pending.

A-17.requirement: Normalise the business type to the trade list (NIC-2008 codes, multilingual synonyms); record the sector
A-17.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-17.acceptance_test: Organiser trades map consistently with reviewable uncertain matches

A-18.requirement: Parse village, block or mandal or taluka, district, state and PIN; normalise against the India Post pincode directory and LGD codes; geocode with a precision level (PIN, village, block, district)
A-18.local_strategy: India Post/LGD data; cached policy-compliant OSM lookup
A-18.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-18.acceptance_test: Precision recorded; no exact private address sent externally

A-19.requirement: Embed an "idea fingerprint" (trade, offering, customers, model) and find nearest neighbours within the user's scope; cluster per cohort and district (section 15)
A-19.local_strategy: Local multilingual embeddings, cosine; local cluster/UMAP candidates
dependencies: Cited fields; org scope; benchmark model
A-19.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-19.acceptance_test: Nearest-neighbour/parity/saturation fixtures pass within viewer scope

A-20.requirement: Query OpenStreetMap for places matching the trade's tags around the location at 1, 3 and 10 km; optionally Google Places; add PitchPrism's own nearby submissions; cache results (section 16)
A-20.implementation: Nearby businesses with dated source evidence
A-20.local_strategy: OpenStreetMap cached lookups; no paid Places default
A-20.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-20.acceptance_test: 1/3/10 km results show source/date/coverage and no invented businesses

A-21.requirement: Match district, trade, gender and social category against the curated schemes dataset; add official district statistics where available. The LLM only phrases what the data returns
A-21.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-21.acceptance_test: Each match cites source/date; missing context remains unknown

A-22.requirement: Score each domain 1 to 5 with a reason, evidence segment IDs and a confidence level. Run twice; if any domain differs by more than 1 point, flag for close review. Potential, completeness, band, quadrant and pathway are computed in code, not by the LLM
A-22.implementation: Double-run domain scoring and deterministic totals
A-22.local_strategy: Local structured model for cited domain judgements; arithmetic in code
A-22.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-22.acceptance_test: Null for unassessed, correct potential/completeness/pathway; parity gap ≤5

A-23.requirement: Strengths, gaps, risks, items to validate and interview questions, each citing segments or checks
A-23.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-23.acceptance_test: Every strength/gap/risk/claim cites a segment or computed check

A-24.requirement: Draft the plan in English following the EDP Business Plan structure, with the financial section computed from the applicant's numbers; translate and voice it for read-back (M-10)

A-27.requirement: Routing rules filter partners by trade, sector and district, then by the entrepreneur's consent. Each suggestion shows its reason
A-27.local_strategy: Rules over trade/sector/district/consent; no model needed
A-27.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.

A-28.requirement: Publish each stage's result as it finishes, so the dashboard card fills in progressively over server-sent events
A-28.implementation: Live incremental card and stage events
A-28.local_strategy: MongoDB job leases and durable capped stage events followed by a tailable cursor, scoped SSE; no Redis or hosted AI
A-28.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-28.acceptance_test: Events scoped to viewer; reconnect does not lose or invent completed stages
A-28.notes: Each stage is published as it finishes and the centre card fills in over SSE (scoped, resumable). Intake stages run when Dev 1 adds them to the worker; until then they are skipped for already-extracted evidence and fail visibly otherwise.

A-29.requirement: Log model, tokens, cost and duration per stage
A-29.local_strategy: Local timing/model/token/API-cost metrics; no paid telemetry dependency
A-29.cost_exposure: ₹0 hosted AI API; local CPU/RAM/disk/electricity remain. Open-data calls require cache/policy compliance.
A-29.acceptance_test: Log model/latency/tokens/API cost without prompts/PII; attempt blocks visible
A-29.notes: Timings and model use are recorded per stage; numbers fill in when the worker runs real stages.
